tools.name: eventee_get_program
tools.description: The whole program of the event the API token belongs to: halls, event days, sessions (`lectures`, type 0), workshops (type 1, with capacity and bookings), breaks (`pauses`), speakers and labels (`tracks`). Use it to read back ids (hall_id, speaker ids, label ids, session ids) before changing anythin

tools.name: eventee_list_participants
tools.description: Participants of the event (attendees, speakers, moderators, admins) with role, group, tickets, check-in time and registration time. `role`: a = admin, m = moderator, l = speaker, e = attendee. `checked_at` is null until checked in. Anonymous participants and deleted accounts have a placeholder email

tools.name: eventee_list_registrations
tools.description: Registrations of the event (people who registered or were pre-registered) with status (pending / confirmed / declined), group, contact details and registration-form answers. Filters apply after the full list is read; use limit/offset for large events. GET /public/api/v1/registrations.

tools.name: eventee_list_groups
tools.description: Attendee groups of the event with the app features enabled for each (agenda, questions, polling, networking, ratings, ...), the ticket names that put people into the group automatically, and which group is the default. Use the ids as group_id when inviting or registering people. GET /public/api/v1/g

tools.name: eventee_list_reviews
tools.description: Session ratings left by attendees (1-5 stars with optional comment), each with the rated session, plus a per-session summary (count and average stars; the 50 most reviewed sessions, `summary_truncated` says if more exist: use session_id for a specific one). Filters apply after the full list is read.

tools.name: eventee_list_partners
tools.description: Partners (sponsors and exhibitors) of the event with company details, contact data, code and page sections. GET /public/api/v1/partners.

tools.name: eventee_create_session
tools.description: WRITE: add a session (lecture or workshop) to the event program. It appears in the event app for attendees. The event day is taken from `start` and created if missing. The hall, speakers and labels must already exist (create them first and pass their ids). POST /public/api/v1/lecture.

tools.name: eventee_update_session
tools.description: WRITE: replace a session (full update, not a patch). Eventee RESETS what is omitted: speakers, labels, type, capacity and the Q&A / moderation / polling switches, so `type`, `speaker_ids`, `label_ids`, `capacity`, `discussion`, `moderating` and `polling` are required here; read the session first wit

tools.name: eventee_delete_session
tools.description: WRITE, IRREVERSIBLE: delete a session (lecture or workshop) together with its questions, polls, workshop bookings and ratings. Needs confirm: true (without it: a preview, nothing deleted). DELETE /public/api/v1/lecture/{session_id}.

tools.name: eventee_create_hall
tools.description: WRITE: add a hall (room, stage or virtual space) to the event. Use the returned id as hall_id for sessions. POST /public/api/v1/hall.

tools.name: eventee_create_break
tools.description: WRITE: add a break (coffee, lunch...) to the event program on the day of `start` (created if missing). POST /public/api/v1/pause.

tools.name: eventee_create_label
tools.description: WRITE: add a label (track) for sessions, with a colour. Use the returned id in label_ids of a session. POST /public/api/v1/label.

tools.name: eventee_create_speaker
tools.description: WRITE: add a speaker profile to the event (shown in the event app). Use the returned id in speaker_ids of a session. The photo, if given, is downloaded by Eventee from the URL. POST /public/api/v1/speaker.

tools.name: eventee_invite_attendees
tools.description: WRITE: add up to 100 people to the event as attendees, optionally with a group and tickets. People who already have an Eventee account are added directly; others get a profile that links when they sign up with the same email. tools.name: eventee_register_people
tools.description: WRITE: pre-register up to 100 people for the event (an existing registration with the same email is updated, not duplicated). tools.name: eventee_check_in_attendee
tools.description: WRITE: check a participant in at the event (sets checked_at to now) or undo the check-in. Use the participant `id` from eventee_list_participants. Fails if the person is not a participant of the event. PATCH /public/api/v1/attendee/{attendee_id}/checkin.

tools.name: eventee_remove_attendee
tools.description: WRITE, IRREVERSIBLE: remove the person with this email from the event: their participation, invitation and tickets for this event are deleted (their Eventee account is not). Eventee reports success even when nobody had that email. Needs confirm: true (without it: a preview, nothing removed). DELETE

tools.name: eventee_remove_registration
tools.description: WRITE, IRREVERSIBLE: delete the registration with this email. Eventee reports success even when no such registration exists. Needs confirm: true (without it: a preview, nothing deleted). DELETE /public/api/v1/registration?email=.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "eventee_invite_attendees" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: eventee_list_participants, eventee_list_groups, eventee_list_reviews, eventee_invite_attendees, eventee_register_people · Private data: eventee_get_program, eventee_list_registrations, eventee_list_partners · Public sink: eventee_list_participants, eventee_create_session, eventee_create_hall, eventee_create_break, eventee_create_label, eventee_create_speaker, eventee_invite_attendees, eventee_register_people, eventee_remove_attendee, eventee_remove_registration · Destructive: eventee_delete_session, eventee_remove_attendee, eventee_remove_registration.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: eventee_list_participants, eventee_list_groups, eventee_list_reviews, eventee_invite_attendees, eventee_register_people · Private data: eventee_get_program, eventee_list_registrations, eventee_list_partners · Public sink: eventee_list_participants, eventee_create_session, eventee_create_hall, eventee_create_break, eventee_create_label, eventee_create_speaker, eventee_invite_attendees, eventee_register_people, eventee_remove_attendee, eventee_remove_registration · Destructive: eventee_delete_session, eventee_remove_attendee, eventee_remove_registration

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
